_meta.description: 200 body of POST /api/invites/{inviteId}/resend (rest-api.md §7.5.4) — the PATH row after a re-mint. `inviteId` is UNCHANGED (a client holding it keeps working) and `createdAt` is UNCHANGED (the owner's 'sent {ago}' line still refers to the original send); only `code` and `expiresAt` move. Every sibling row sharing the previous code was re-minted in the SAME transaction and carries this same new code. MYR-368 — A RESEND RE-SIGNS: the new code and the new expiry produce a whole new `shareUrl`, so the previous LINK stops redeeming along with the previous code. The shape here is the contract's (parameters in `k`, `from`, `to` order; `k` = keyId.expUnix.base64url-sig; 1786006800 is this row's `expiresAt` in UNIX seconds); the 86 signature characters are ILLUSTRATIVE, because §7.5.4 prints no example and no client key can produce a real one.
